title: I built an idle/management voxel game where you run a newsroom full of monkeys who write up (and fail at) news stories. Could really use play testers.
author: Gridiron_Geek_
selftext:
I've been working on this for a little while, and I know it's kind of a weird idea, but I think it turned out pretty cool. 

You hire monkeys, stick them at typewriters, and they work away at random keys until they occasionally hit the right key. Every morning at dawn the paper prints whether it's finished or not, so whatever they didn't get to goes out as random gibberish. Sometimes the gibberish accidentally spells a real word, which the game counts as a "lucky misprint" and honestly those are my favorite parts

There's more to it once it gets going (rival papers, picking your front page story, townspeople wandering in to complain), but I'd rather you find that stuff yourself.

It runs in the browser, it's free, and your progress saves.

What I'd really love to know:

\- How long until you got bored, if you did?

\- Was anything confusing in the first 10 minutes or so?

\- Did you want to keep playing after your first few papers?

Brutal honesty is welcome, I'd rather hear it now.





The game is here: [https://photonslayer.itch.io/the-monkey-gazette](https://photonslayer.itch.io/the-monkey-gazette)
